text: Thirteen years after an earthquake in Haiti forced photographer Victor Fielding into [a choice he has never admitted|wrong|broken trust], he raises his daughter Angela alone in Georgia. Angela and her best friend Katherine slip into the woods to [hold a séance for her dead mother|trigger|calling on unseen powers] and vanish for three days. They return with burned feet, [both girls taken by the same demon|threat|being taken over]. When the families gather for an exorcism, [the demon demands they choose which girl will die|rules|everything has a price].
